은행.x: I withdrew money at the bank.
은행.e: Literally 'silver firm' — from the days when money meant silver.
은행.t: In fast speech it sounds like [으냉]: ㅎ between sounds is weak and often dropped.

태풍.ex: 태풍 때문에 오늘 비행기가 모두 취소됐어요.
태풍.x: All of today's flights were canceled because of the typhoon.
태풍.e: Sounds like English 'typhoon' — the two words are probably related.

실력.e: Literally 'real power' — what you can actually do.
실력.t: Common collocation: 실력이 늘다 'skills improve'; 실력이 좋다 'to be skilled'.

잃다.x: Many people lost their homes in the accident.
잃다.t: Pronounced [일타], but 잃어요 is [이러요] — the ㅎ goes silent before vowels.

어묵.x: On cold days, fish cake broth is the best.
어묵.e: 어 'fish' + 묵 'jelly, curd' — pressed fish paste.
어묵.t: Many people still say 오뎅 (from Japanese 'oden'); 어묵 is the standard word. Street stalls serve skewers with free broth.

이익.x: This year we made a lot more profit than last year.

금액.x: Please check the amount and sign here.

매력.ex: 그 배우는 목소리에 특별한 매력이 있어요.
매력.x: That actor's voice has a special charm.

어색하다.ex: 처음 만난 사람과 이야기하는 것이 좀 어색해요.
어색하다.x: Talking with someone I've just met feels a bit awkward.
어색하다.e: Literally 'words blocked': when you can't find anything to say.
어색하다.t: Also used for unnatural sentences: 이 문장은 좀 어색해요 means 'this sentence sounds a bit off.'

반성.x: After making a mistake, you need to reflect on it.
반성.t: 반성 means learning from mistakes; 후회 just means wishing you hadn't.

희망.x: Don't lose hope, even in a hard situation.
희망.t: Pronounced [히망]: 희 is said like 히.

알약.ex: 이 알약은 하루에 두 번 드세요.
알약.x: Take this pill twice a day.
알약.e: Native 알 'grain, egg' plus 약 'medicine': medicine in little grains.
알약.t: Pronounced [알략] — ㄴ is added and becomes ㄹ.

수백.ex: 그 영상에 하루 만에 댓글이 수백 개 달렸어요.
수백.x: That video got hundreds of comments in a single day.
수백.t: Combine with 만 for bigger amounts: 수백만 명 'millions of people'.

희생.m: sacrifice; loss of life (in an accident or disaster)
희생.ex: 많은 사람들의 희생으로 나라를 지킬 수 있었어요.
희생.x: The country could be defended thanks to the sacrifice of many people.
희생.e: Originally an animal offered in ancient rituals.
희생.t: Pronounced [히생] — ㅢ after a consonant sounds like [ㅣ].

분명.ex: 그 사람은 분명 내일 올 거예요.

간이 콩알만 해지다.forms: 간이 콩알만 해져요 · 간이 콩알만 해졌어요 · 간이 콩알만 해질 거예요
간이 콩알만 해지다.m: to be scared stiff, to have your heart in your mouth
간이 콩알만 해지다.ex: 갑자기 큰 소리가 나서 간이 콩알만 해졌어요.
간이 콩알만 해지다.x: There was a sudden loud noise, and I nearly jumped out of my skin.
간이 콩알만 해지다.e: Literally 'your liver shrinks to the size of a bean'—courage vanishes.
간이 콩알만 해지다.t: A similar way to say you got a big fright: 간 떨어질 뻔했어요 'my liver nearly fell out'.

연승.x: Our team is on a five-game winning streak.
연승.e: Literally 'wins in a row.' 연- = consecutive: 연휴, 연속.

진동벨.m: vibrating pager, buzzer (given at cafés and food courts)
진동벨.x: When the buzzer goes off, please come to the counter.
진동벨.t: At most cafés and food courts you order, take a 진동벨, and pick up your order when it buzzes.

안정감.m: sense of stability, feeling of security
안정감.ex: 가족과 함께 있으면 마음에 안정감이 생겨요.
안정감.x: Being with my family gives me a sense of security.
안정감.e: Literally 'a feeling of being peaceful and settled'.

계승하다.m: to carry on, to inherit, to succeed to
계승하다.x: We must carry on our traditional culture well.
계승하다.e: Literally 'continue and receive' from those before.

보복.ex: 정부는 상대국의 보복 관세에 강하게 대응했습니다.
보복.x: The government responded strongly to the other country's retaliatory tariffs.
보복.t: 복수 is personal revenge; 보복 is common for states and organizations: 보복 공격, 보복 조치.

이행하다.m: to fulfill, to carry out (a promise, duty, contract)
이행하다.ex: 그 회사는 계약 조건을 성실하게 이행했습니다.
이행하다.x: The company faithfully fulfilled the terms of the contract.
이행하다.e: Literally 'step out and do' — following through on what you promised.
이행하다.t: A homonym 이행 (different hanja) means 'transition,' as in 시장 경제로 이행하다.

짓눌리다.m: to be crushed, to be weighed down, to be overwhelmed
짓눌리다.ex: 그는 업무 스트레스에 짓눌려 잠을 못 자요.
짓눌리다.x: He's so weighed down by work stress that he can't sleep.
짓눌리다.e: 짓- 'hard, roughly' (as in 짓밟다 'to trample') + 눌리다 'to be pressed'.

충동성.ex: 충동성이 강한 사람은 쇼핑을 할 때 조심해야 해요.
충동성.x: People with strong impulsivity need to be careful when shopping.

임명.ex: 새 장관 임명을 두고 논란이 계속되고 있어요.
임명.x: Controversy continues over the appointment of the new minister.

검색어.ex: 검색어를 정확하게 입력하면 원하는 정보를 빨리 찾을 수 있어요.
검색어.x: If you type an accurate search term, you can find the information you want quickly.

유목.ex: 몽골 사람들은 오랫동안 유목 생활을 해 왔어요.
유목.x: Mongolians have lived a nomadic life for a long time.

회상하다.m: to recall, to look back on, to reminisce about
회상하다.ex: 할머니는 젊은 시절을 회상하며 미소를 지으셨어요.
회상하다.x: Grandma smiled as she looked back on her younger days.

기간산업.x: Steel and power are a nation's typical key industries.
기간산업.e: Literally 'base-and-trunk industry' — the trunk the rest of the economy grows from.
기간산업.t: Don't confuse with 기간 期間 'period of time' — same sound, different hanja.

번역본.ex: 이 소설은 영어 번역본으로 먼저 읽었어요.
번역본.x: I first read this novel in its English translation.
번역본.e: Literally 'translated copy'; -본 = edition or copy: 원본, 판본.

갓.ex: 조선 시대 양반들은 외출할 때 갓을 썼어요.
갓.x: Joseon aristocrats wore a gat when they went out.
갓.e: Homonym warning: 갓 also means 'just, freshly' (갓 구운 빵) and is a mustard leaf.
갓.t: Hats use 쓰다: 갓을 쓰다. Pronounced [갇]; 갓이 sounds like [가시].

참칭하다.m: to falsely assume a title, to usurp a name
참칭하다.ex: 그는 스스로 왕을 참칭하며 반란을 일으켰습니다.
참칭하다.x: He falsely proclaimed himself king and started a rebellion.
참칭하다.e: Literally 'overstep in calling oneself' — claiming a title one has no right to.
참칭하다.t: Compare 사칭하다 'to impersonate' (e.g. a police officer); 참칭 is for titles like king or emperor.

화합하다.m: to be in harmony, to unite; to combine (chemistry)
화합하다.ex: 모든 세대가 화합하는 사회를 만들어야 합니다.
화합하다.x: We must build a society where all generations live in harmony.
화합하다.e: Literally 'harmonize and join' — people coming together peacefully.

편중.x: The population is overly concentrated in the capital region.

남가일몽.x: Wealth and glory are, in the end, nothing but a fleeting dream.
남가일몽.e: A man dreamed of a lifetime of glory, then woke under the south branch of a tree.

화이부동.m: getting along with others without blindly conforming
화이부동.ex: 좋은 동료 관계는 화이부동의 자세에서 시작됩니다.
화이부동.x: Good relationships with colleagues start with being harmonious without simply conforming.
화이부동.e: From Confucius: a gentleman is in harmony with others but not identical to them.

투석.ex: 아버지는 일주일에 세 번 투석을 받으세요.
투석.x: My father gets dialysis three times a week.
투석.e: Literally 'filter through and separate': waste is filtered out of the blood.
투석.t: Homonym: 투석 (投石) means 'throwing stones', as in protests; use the 받다 pattern for dialysis.
